name: Vilnius Historic Centre
description: Vilnius's Old Town, in Lithuania's capital, is one of the largest surviving medieval centres in Northern Europe. Its tangle of lanes holds Gothic, Renaissance, Baroque and neoclassical buildings side by side, along with Catholic, Lutheran and Orthodox churches. You can wander lively Pilies Street, or explore the university's 13 courtyards, in a city that was the Grand Duchy of Lithuania's capital.
